title: PR #214: Competitive monitoring baseline and snapshots (2026-10-19–2026-10-22)
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

Adds the 2026-10-21 evidence-based report and registry snapshot v0.2.2 (14 provider/product lines, 14 ADD/UPDATE deltas) alongside the 2026-10-19 baseline. The v0.2.2 registry supersedes the same-day v0.2.1 file and corrects baseline classifications/delta semantics. Bubble's official 2026-10-20 price transition is recorded as STATUS_CHANGED; Linux mainline 7.3 remains separate from stable 6.18.y. Missing/conflicting evidence is UNVERIFIED.

## Follow-up snapshot — 2026-10-22

This PR also includes the targeted 2026-10-22 report and registry delta overlay:
- `competitive-monitoring/reports/2026-10-22.md`
- `competitive-monitoring/registry/2026-10-22-v0.2.3.json`

The v0.2.3 file is explicitly a `DELTA_OVERLAY` extending v0.2.2, not a fully expanded registry or full market census. Its three deltas cover BeyondTrust AI Agent Security GA, Linux stable 7.2.12, and the BeyondTrust Entitle–ServiceNow integration. The BeyondTrust GA announcement and integration announcement were checked against the official vendor press pages; the Linux 7.2.12 release date and cited KVM/ksmbd/MANA changes were checked against kernel.org's official changelog. The reported +43% MANA result is specific to the changelog's stated Azure VM forwarding workload and must not be generalized.

Commit containing the current v0.2.3 overlay: `0ecab0906653a041a0424265ea4f03bfd80a5e5b`. Registry blob SHA: `89513ff30bf4f77c98bd9ee1df13135d2615fcb5`.

This remains a targeted review, not a full market census. The overlay has not independently verified every claim in the report, the registry is not yet fully expanded, and daily automation/comparison logic is not implemented. Keep this PR Draft and unmerged until those limitations are addressed and the complete diff/evidence is reviewed.

## Registry consistency and validation follow-up

This follow-up adds:
- `competitive-monitoring/registry/2026-10-22-expanded-v0.2.3.json`: a 15-entry expanded registry derived from v0.2.2 plus the three v0.2.3 overlay operations. The inherited records retain their existing evidence levels; BeyondTrust GA/integration and Linux 7.2.12 claims have targeted official-source checks only.
- `competitive-monitoring/tools/validate_registry.py`: deterministic checks for stable IDs, required fields, source URLs/statuses, price metadata, and overlay operation targets.
- `competitive-monitoring/tests/test_validate_registry.py`: negative tests for duplicate IDs, missing sources, invalid statuses, incomplete price metadata, unresolved UPDATEs, duplicate ADDs, and invalid delta types.
- `.github/workflows/competitive-monitoring-validation.yml`: pull-request/push validation, daily schedule, and machine-readable artifact output.

Validation evidence:
- First run exposed a test import-path defect (run [39749765395](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39749765395)); the import path was corrected in commit `4359c2999b31990fdb38f1f3e6cf4814220ce1ea`.
- Validation passed on exact head commit `4359c2999b31990fdb38f1f3e6cf4814220ce1ea`: [run 39749858791](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39749858791). All 8 unit/negative tests passed; the validator returned `PASS` for 15 entries, unique IDs, source URL checks, price metadata checks, and overlay target checks. Machine-readable artifact: `competitive-monitoring-validation-evidence`.
- The schedule will execute from the default branch after the workflow is merged; while this PR remains Draft, push/PR-triggered validation is the available evidence.
- This workflow validates persisted registry data; it does not yet crawl vendor sources or autonomously produce a new daily delta.

Keep this PR Draft and unmerged until the current validator run passes, the full diff is reviewed, and remaining evidence gaps are resolved.

- Audit script was run against the ecosystem repository while loading `atc-standards/main` at `68448117334b49729f423f1648f9a960f4411220`. This is a repository governance/commit-history compliance failure, not a registry resolver failure.
- Latest check-run snapshot: 30 checks total, 20 completed, 18 successful, 1 failed, and 10 still pending/in progress (one completed check is neither success nor failure in the API snapshot).

Required next action: inspect the exact commit subjects/history used by V-16 and remediate the Conventional Commits compliance without rewriting protected/shared history or weakening the standard; rerun the governance gate. Do not treat the dedicated registry workflow's PASS as an overall PR pass.

## V-16 root-cause detail — 2026-10-22

The failed governance audit was rechecked against the exact logs and the branch commit list. The validator in `atc-standards/main` at `68448117334b49729f423f1648f9a960f4411220` runs `git log --oneline -20`, excludes merge commits, then applies its Conventional Commits regex. The current PR branch's recent history contains predominantly non-conventional subjects (for example, `Sync expanded registry with explicit Ledger uncertainty delta`, `Declare unresolved Ledger price effective date in overlay`, and `Refresh overlay provenance SHA in expanded registry`); the log reports 10%, below the hard 80% threshold.

This is a **commit-history compliance** failure, not a registry-content defect. Adding a single conventional commit cannot establish an 80% rate for the existing 20-commit sample. The compliant remedies are to normalize the PR branch's commit subjects in an isolated rewrite/replacement branch and re-run all checks, or to raise a separate standards change if V-16 is intended to assess the repository's default-branch history rather than PR-supplied history. Do not weaken the 80% threshold or claim this PR has passed V-16. No history rewrite has been performed; this draft PR remains unmerged.
